{
  "name": "expo-sdk54-navigation",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Expo SDK 54 navigation template",
  "private": true,
  "main": "index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "expo start",
    "android": "expo run:android",
    "web": "expo start --web",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint:ci": "eslint . --quiet",
    "test:silent": "jest --silent",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "expo": "~54.0.32",
    "react": "19.1.0",
    "react-dom": "19.1.0",
    "react-native": "0.81.5",
    "react-native-web": "^0.21.1"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/react": "~19.1.10",
    "@types/react-dom": "~19.1.5",
    "@types/jest": "^29.5.14",
    "eslint": "^9.0.0",
    "eslint-config-expo": "~10.0.0",
    "jest": "^29.7.0",
    "jest-expo": "~54.0.16",
    "typescript": "~5.9.3"
  }
}

# ============================================================
# EAS BUILD IGNORE – optimiert für k1w1-a0style
# ============================================================

# Node Stuff
node_modules/
pnpm-lock.yaml
npm-debug.log*

# Expo / Metro Cache
.expo/
.expo-shared/
.cache/
.expo-go/
.expo-staging/
web-build/
dist/
build/

# Supabase CLI Cache
supabase/.temp
supabase/.cache
supabase/functions/**/node_modules

# Git / Workspace Stuff
.git/
.gitignore
.github/

# images / local junk
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# Android / iOS native not used (Expo managed)
android/
ios/

# Editor junk
.vscode/
.idea/

# Logs & temps
*.log
logs/
tmp/
temp/

# OS Junk
*.orig
*.backup
*.backup2
*.backup3
*~

// jest.config.js
module.exports = {
  preset: 'jest-expo',

  testMatch: [
    '<rootDir>/__tests__/**/*.test.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)',
    '<rootDir>/lib/__tests__/**/*.test.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)',
  ],

  setupFilesAfterEnv: [
    '<rootDir>/jest.setup.js',
  ],

  // WICHTIG: Expo-Module + expo-modules-core müssen transpiled werden
  transformIgnorePatterns: [
    'node_modules/(?!(jest-)?react-native' +
      '|@react-native' +
      '|@react-navigation' +
      '|expo(nent)?' +
      '|@expo(nent)?/.*' +
      '|expo-modules-core' +
      '|react-native-reanimated' +
      '|react-native-gesture-handler' +
      '|react-native-screens' +
      '|react-native-safe-area-context' +
      '|@unimodules' +
      '|unimodules' +
      ')',
  ],
};
